notes: No local measures on the November 3, 2026 ballot: the Skamania County sample ballot (https://www.skamaniacounty.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/19606/639256882368200000) and local voters' pamphlet (https://www.skamaniacounty.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/19600/639253463106470000) list only the statewide measures IP26-645, IL26-001 and IL26-638, and VoteWA's online voters' guide for county 30 lists no local measure.

Skamania County Commissioner District 3 is nominated by district and elected county-wide in the general (RCW 36.32.040, RCW 36.32.050(1)); Public Utility District No. 1 of Skamania County covers the whole county (WA DOR PUD2025, layer 17) and every PUD voter elects each commissioner (RCW 54.12.010(3)). Both are scoped COUNTY.
